<style>
:root{--bg:#f5f2ff;--card:#ffffff;--ink:#17133a;--mute:#5a5680;--red:#5b4bff;--pink:#ffcf8a;--line:#ddd7fb;--btn:#17133a;--btnt:#fff;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0e0c26;--card:#181545;--ink:#f1eeff;--mute:#b3aedd;--red:#7b6dff;--pink:#3a2a5e;--line:#2d2970;--btn:#f1eeff;--btnt:#17133a}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0e0c26;--card:#181545;--ink:#f1eeff;--mute:#b3aedd;--red:#7b6dff;--pink:#3a2a5e;--line:#2d2970;--btn:#f1eeff;--btnt:#17133a}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;line-height:1.65;overflow-x:hidden}
h1,h2,h3,.disp{font-family:Syne,sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
section{padding:80px 0}
.sec h2{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,38px);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1}
.sec small{display:block;color:var(--red);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
.sec .bar{width:64px;height:2px;background:var(--red);margin:14px 0 34px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--btn);color:var(--btnt);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:99px;border:2px solid var(--red);font:600 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.btn.alt{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
/* loader */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--bg);z-index:99;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;transition:opacity .6s,visibility .6s}
#loader.off{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#loader svg{width:110px;animation:pop 1s ease both}
#loader b{display:block;font:700 30px Syne,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;margin-top:6px}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.6);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
/* nav */
nav{position:fixed;top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:50;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;max-width:calc(100% - 20px)}
.pill{display:flex;gap:2px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 80%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:5px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.pill a{padding:7px 14px;border-radius:99px;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.pill a.on{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
.tg{padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px}
.logo-pill{display:none}
@media(min-width:760px){.logo-pill{display:grid;place-items:center;width:52px;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 80%,transparent)}.logo-pill svg{width:26px}}
@media(max-width:620px){.dl{display:none}}
/* side socials */
.side{position:fixed;left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;z-index:40;font:600 14px Syne,sans-serif}
@media(min-width:1100px){.side{display:flex}}
/* hero */
.hero{min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;padding:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(110% 90% at 80% 50%,#6a5cff 0%,#b9a8ff 34%,var(--bg) 78%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.hero .name{position:absolute;top:8%;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font:800 clamp(64px,15vw,180px)/1 Syne,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.hero .ph{position:absolute;bottom:50px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-30%);height:78%;aspect-ratio:3/4;max-width:90vw;display:grid;place-items:center}
.hero .ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:999px 999px 28px 28px;border:5px solid #ffffffb0;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -18px #1a1060aa}
.hero .txt{position:relative;z-index:3;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;padding:0 6vw 120px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(20px,3.2vw,34px);line-height:1.15;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.hero .l{max-width:340px;color:var(--ink)}
.hero .l p{font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 16px}
.hero .r{text-align:right}
.avail{font-size:12px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.avail:before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#35c759}
.tick{position:absolute;left:-5%;right:-5%;bottom:0;z-index:4;background:var(--red);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:12px 0;font:600 17px 'DM Sans',sans-serif}
.tick div{display:inline-block;animation:run 24s linear infinite}
@keyframes run{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media(max-width:700px){.hero .ph{height:62%;transform:translateX(-50%)}.hero .txt{padding-bottom:90px}.hero .r{text-align:left}}
/* photo placeholder */
.empty{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:#fff;border:2px dashed #fff8;border-radius:40% 40% 0 0;background:#0003;padding:20px}
/* about */
.about{display:grid;gap:40px;grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:800px){.about{grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr}}
.blob{width:min(320px,80%);aspect-ratio:1;margin:auto;border-radius:48% 52% 45% 55%/55% 45% 55% 45%;overflow:hidden;background:#2a2470;box-shadow:0 0 50px #5b4bff55;cursor:pointer}
.blob img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.abox{background:var(--card);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.abox h3{font-size:30px;margin:10px 0}.abox h3 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.abox p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px;margin-top:12px}
.chip{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--red);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--red)}
.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:50px}
.tools div{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;text-align:center;font-size:13px}
.tools b{display:block;font:700 26px Syne,sans-serif;color:var(--red)}
/* why */
.why li{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:20px;padding:16px 0 16px 18px;border-left:2px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);max-width:620px}
.why li:hover{border-left-color:var(--red)}
.why .n{font:700 34px Syne,sans-serif;color:var(--red);opacity:.6;min-width:46px}
.why h3{font-size:14px;text-transform:uppercase}.why p{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}
.brands{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:20px}
.brands span{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 16px;font-size:13px}
/* services */
.grid4{display:grid;gap:16px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr))}
.svc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.svc h3{font-size:18px;text-transform:uppercase}
.svc ul{padding-left:18px;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;flex:1}
.svc a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px;font:600 13px DM Sans}
.svc a i{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal}
/* clients/stats */
.logos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:14px}
.logos div{height:80px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px Syne,sans-serif;color:var(--mute)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:40px}
.stats div{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.stats b{display:block;font:700 42px Syne,sans-serif}.stats span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
/* works */
.works{display:grid;gap:16px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr))}
.w{aspect-ratio:3/2;border-radius:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:14px;color:#fff;font:600 14px DM Sans}
.w:nth-child(1){background:linear-gradient(#e9d34a,#b8a118)}.w:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(#8a1020,#2a0408)}.w:nth-child(3){background:linear-gradient(#7b2fd0,#3b0f78)}
.w span{position:relative;text-shadow:0 1px 6px #0008}
.more{text-align:center;margin-top:24px}
/* reviews */
.rev{display:grid;gap:24px;grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:center}
@media(min-width:700px){.rev{grid-template-columns:200px 1fr}}
.rev .av{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:18px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 36px Syne,sans-serif;color:var(--red)}
.rev q{font:500 19px/1.6 DM Sans;display:block;margin:8px 0 16px}
.stars{color:#f2b01e;font-size:14px}
.arr{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--btn);color:var(--btnt);border:0;margin-right:6px;cursor:pointer}
/* contact */
.cgrid{display:grid;gap:20px;grid-template-columns:1fr}
@media(min-width:800px){.cgrid{grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr}}
form,.cbox{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:12px}
label{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);display:grid;gap:4px}
input,select,textarea{font:14px DM Sans;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);width:100%}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.row{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--bg);font-size:14px}
.row small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:11px}
/* footer */
.cta{background:var(--pink);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink);text-align:center;padding:44px 20px}
.cta h2{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,40px);text-transform:uppercase;margin:6px 0 10px}
.cta .btn{margin:6px 4px}
.foot{display:grid;gap:24px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));padding:30px 6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
.foot h4{font:700 13px Syne,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px;text-transform:uppercase}
.foot a{display:block;margin:4px 0}
.copy{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);padding-bottom:30px}

[dir=rtl] .hero .r{text-align:left}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px}
.w[data-bg]{background-size:cover;background-position:center}.w[data-bg]:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 45%,#000b)}.bwrap{position:relative;width:min(320px,80%);margin:auto}.bwrap .blob{width:100%}.blob img{object-position:50% 30%}.mini{position:absolute;right:-8px;bottom:-12px;width:32%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid var(--bg);overflow:hidden}.mini img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
#loader svg,.logo-pill svg,.foot svg{color:var(--ink)}#loader svg{height:88px}
</style>

for(var i=0;i<12;i++)h+=items.map(function(t){return '<span style="margin:0 20px">'+t+'</span><span>✳</span>'}).join('');
$('#tk').innerHTML=h;
// logos
// photos
$('#hp').src=IMG.hero;$('#ab').src=IMG.about;$('#mn').src=IMG.mini;
$$('[data-bg]').forEach(function(e){e.style.backgroundImage='url('+IMG[e.dataset.bg]+')'});
// scrollspy
var ids=['home','about','services','clients','works','contact'],links=$$('#pill a');
function spy(){var y=scrollY+140,cur=0;ids.forEach(function(id,i){var e=document.getElementById(id);if(e&&e.offsetTop<=y)cur=i});
 links.forEach(function(a,i){a.classList.toggle('on',i===cur)})}
addEventListener('scroll',spy,{passive:true});spy();
// theme
$('#theme').onclick=function(){var d=document.documentElement,dark=getComputedStyle(d).getPropertyValue('--bg').trim()==='#0e0c26';d.setAttribute('data-theme',dark?'light':'dark')};
// language (nav + hero only)
var ar=false,AR={Home:'الرئيسية',About:'من أنا',Services:'الخدمات',Clients:'خطوات العمل',Works:'أعمالي',Contact:'تواصل',h1a:'ببني وبصمم مواقع',h1b:'يخلّي براندك مرئي.',avail:'متاح لمشاريع جديدة في أي وقت',heroP:'ببني مواقع من الصفر، وبعدّل وبطوّر المواقع والتطبيقات الموجودة، وبصمم تصاميم نضيفة تخلي براندك شكله محترف.',start:'ابدأ مشروعك ←',view:'شوف أعمالي'};
var EN={};$$('[data-t]').forEach(function(e){EN[e.dataset.t]=e.innerHTML});
$('#lang').onclick=function(){ar=!ar;document.documentElement.dir=ar?'rtl':'ltr';this.textContent=ar?'EN':'AR';
 $$('[data-t]').forEach(function(e){var k=e.dataset.t;e.innerHTML=ar?(k==='h1b'?'يخلّي براندك <em>مرئي</em>.':AR[k]):EN[k]})};
$('#f').addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var t='Hi Yousef\nName: '+$('#fn').value+'\nService: '+$('#fs').value+'\nDetails: '+($('#fd').value||'-');window.open('https://wa.me/201284787334?text='+encodeURIComponent(t),'_blank')});
})();
</script>
